title: Sotsiaal.pro vestlus pärast ADR-154 ja ADR-155 (juhis 46, otsingu teine lugemine, loetelu järg, admini jälg) — eelregistreering
server: sotsiaal.pro after the deploy of the ADR-154/155 commit (dialogue prompt m4-grounded-dialogue-46)
costCap: the remaining part of the owner's 1 EUR chat test cap (about 0.27 EUR used); expected about 0.045 USD

method.entry: POST /api/chat with x-rag-pilot: 1 (full turn) from the owner's signed-in ADMIN session, view role per item, restored to none at the end
method.turns: one turn per question in a new conversation, the same question text as before
method.trace: each turn is read in /admin/rag/chat-trace/<turnId> (ADR-154): the packet's reasons, the selection model's pool with fused scores, the additions
method.grading: PASS only when every expected point holds; "cannot be confirmed / decided" while the evidence gives the answer is a FAIL (owner 21.10); a trace point that the packet makes impossible is reported as NOT_APPLICABLE with the reason
method.raters: Claude pre-rating with evidence; owner and one social work specialist rate critical claims (RAG-12)

items.question: Mu täiskasvanud pojal on alkoholisõltuvus. Kas ta saab riigi rahastatud toetatud elamise teenust?
expected: trace: SHS § 72 lg 2 is in the packet as a cross-reference from § 95 (or § 72 lg 2 is there by another reason; then the second reading is not shown by this question)
answer: the state-funded supported living service is not provided to a person whose main illness is an alcohol or drug dependence (SHS § 95 with § 72 lg 2); names what else may help or whom to ask
no limitation or sentence that only says the matter cannot be confirmed or decided when the evidence gives it (owner 21.10: "ei saa kindlalt määrata" is no answer)

items.question: Kas eakate päevakeskus on teenus, mida vald peab seaduse järgi kindlasti pakkuma?
expected: trace: the passages under "Neist täiskasvanutele mõeldud teenused on:" are in the packet as list continuations, if that passage is selected

answer: names the services the municipality must organise (as far as the evidence lists them) and says that an older people's day centre is not among them; a municipality may organise other services; points to the person's own municipality
no limitation or sentence that only says the matter cannot be confirmed or decided when the evidence gives it (owner 21.10: "ei saa kindlalt määrata" is no answer)

items.question: Milline teenuseosutaja pakub Tartus kõige paremat koduteenust?
expected: answer: says first that the city organises koduteenus and how to get it (the city's procedure, if in the evidence), then any provider as its own description; no ranking of providers
no limitation or sentence that only says the matter cannot be confirmed or decided when the evidence gives it (owner 21.10: "ei saa kindlalt määrata" is no answer)

items.question: Olen töötuna arvel. Kui mitu päeva kuus ja kui palju raha võin ajutise töö ehk tööampsuga teenida, nii et arvelolek ei lõpe?
expected: answer: the gross pay limit of 378.40 euros a month (with the date of the page) stands in a block, not only in a hedged limitation; the retroactive end stays (list item 16)
the monthly day unit is reported, not graded (left to the owner and a specialist, ADR-153)

items.question: Minu 70-aastasel isal on dementsus. Kas ta saab riigi rahastatud igapäevaelu toetamise teenust?
expected: answer: no grammatical error of the kind "Kui su isa 70-aastasel isal"
content: the state-funded everyday life support service is not provided to a person of retirement age with dementia (SHS § 88 with § 72 lg 2); points to the municipality's services
no limitation or sentence that only says the matter cannot be confirmed or decided when the evidence gives it (owner 21.10: "ei saa kindlalt määrata" is no answer)

items.question: Taotlen toimetulekutoetust ja maksan iga kuu oma korteri ostuks võetud laenu. Kas laenumakse läheb eluasemekuluna arvesse?
expected: answer: no grammatical error of the kind "peab sa"
content: the repayment of a loan taken to acquire the dwelling, with interest, counts as a housing cost (SHS § 133 lg 5)
no limitation or sentence that only says the matter cannot be confirmed or decided when the evidence gives it (owner 21.10: "ei saa kindlalt määrata" is no answer)

items.question: Ema läheb hooldekodusse ja tema pensionist ei jätku. Kas mina ja mu vend peame puuduva osa maksma?
expected: trace: whether Perekonnaseadus § 96 is among the candidates the selection model read, at which place, and if not, at which place in each channel the maintenance passages stood
answer: adult children owe maintenance to a parent in need (PKS § 96); the municipality's role and the limits of the duty; no sum promised
no limitation or sentence that only says the matter cannot be confirmed or decided when the evidence gives it (owner 21.10: "ei saa kindlalt määrata" is no answer)

items.question: Mis on VIPS-spetsialisti baasõpe ja millal selle piloteerimine algab?
expected: trace: which VIPS / stepped-care documents of corpus v89 were candidates, which the selection model kept, and whether the pilot timing passage was among the candidates
answer: the basic training (24 ECTS, five modules) and the pilot timing (end of 2026 to end of 2027) when the evidence gives them
no limitation or sentence that only says the matter cannot be confirmed or decided when the evidence gives it (owner 21.10: "ei saa kindlalt määrata" is no answer)

limits: The packets may differ from the earlier runs; both are compared.
Expectations come from the earlier runs and the sources read there; a wrong expectation is reported, not changed after seeing answers.

amendments.text: E9 and U01 failed (server-rag-chat-prompt46.json). ADR-156 (prompt 47, search-assist-15, list items after their announcement with continues) is re-tested with the same two questions and the same expectations. Expected cost about 0.012 USD.

E7 failed in the prompt-46 run because the plan query named Tartu, shared by Tartu linn and Tartu vald, while the message's checked place was Tartu linn. ADR-157 lets that checked place choose. E7 is asked again with the same expectations: the city organises koduteenus and how to get it comes first (the city's procedure from the records lane), no ranking of providers, no hedging limitation. The trace must show the records lane with region tartu_linn. Expected cost about 0.006 USD.
